title: Payment Plan Terms for Deficiency Balance Accounts by Resolution Band
content:
The terms on which a Deficiency Balance Account may be repaid under a monthly payment plan are set per Deficiency Resolution Band as follows.

| Term | Band 1 | Band 2 | Band 3 | Band 4 | Band 5 | Band 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum monthly plan installment, USD | $50.00 | $75.00 | $100.00 | $150.00 | $200.00 | $250.00 |
| Minimum monthly plan installment as a percent of the balance on the acceptance date (the installment is the greater of this and the minimum monthly plan installment, rounded up to the cent) | 3.0% | 3.0% | 2.5% | 2.5% | 2.0% | 2.0% |
| Maximum number of monthly plan installments | 24 | 36 | 48 | 60 | 60 | 72 |
| Calendar days a plan offer stays open for acceptance | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Maximum calendar days from acceptance to the first plan installment | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Allowed day-of-month for plan installments, inclusive | 1 to 28 | 1 to 28 | 1 to 28 | 1 to 28 | 1 to 28 | 1 to 28 |
| Calendar days after a plan or settlement installment due date before the arrangement is broken | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Smallest balance eligible for a monthly plan; smaller balances are paid in a lump sum or a small-balance plan, USD | $300.00 | $300.00 | $300.00 | $300.00 | $300.00 | $300.00 |
| Maximum installments for a balance below the smallest balance eligible for a monthly plan | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Down payment, as a percent of the balance, required to start a new plan within 12 months of a broken arrangement | 10.0% | 10.0% | 10.0% | 10.0% | 10.0% | 10.0% |
| Broken plans or settlements in the rolling 12 months after which no new installment arrangement is offered, count | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Cadence of payment-plan installments | monthly on the plan due day | monthly on the plan due day | monthly on the plan due day | monthly on the plan due day | monthly on the plan due day | monthly on the plan due day |

## Notes to the table

- The band is the account's own Deficiency Resolution Band, fixed at opening; the plan terms of that band apply to every plan on the account.
- The due-day range is inclusive: the 1st and the 28th of a month are both allowed plan due days, the 29th, 30th and 31st are not.
- The grace period runs in calendar days from the installment's due date; the figure is the same for plans and installment settlements.
- The smallest-balance figure is a threshold that a balance must reach: a hypothetical balance of exactly $300.00 qualifies for a monthly plan, one of $299.99 does not.
